**Frequently Asked Questions – Ashcombe Bay Tee**

| Question | Answer |
|----------|--------|
| **What material is the Ashcombe Bay tee made of?** | 100 % comb‑cooked organic cotton. Soft, breathable, and eco‑friendly. |
| **Which sizes are available?** | S, M, L, XL, XXL. All sizes are true to size; please consult our size chart before ordering. |
| **Is the print washed‑in or screen‑printed?** | The crest is a long‑lasting, fade‑resistant screen‑print – no added washes, so it stays sharp wash after wash. |
| **Can I machine wash the tee?** | Yes. Wash inside‑out on cold, tumble dry low. Avoid bleach and high heat to keep colours bright. |
| **Will the design shrink?** | The shirt has a loose fit and is pre‑shrank. Gentle machine wash will preserve shape. |
| **Is the crest design generic or a licensed logo?** | The crest is a stylised, fictional seaside town crest, purely for decorative purposes. No real town or trademark is involved. |
| **Do you ship internationally?** | We ship worldwide via standard and express carriers. Shipping costs are calculated at checkout. |
| **Can I return or exchange a tee?** | Returns are accepted within 30 days of receipt in original condition, with return shipping prepaid. Exchanges for size are handled at checkout if the item is in stock. |
| **Do you offer bulk orders or custom listings?** | Yes! Contact us at *bulk@ashcombetee.com* for bulk pricing or custom crest designs on a per‑order basis. |
| **What payment methods do you accept?** | Credit/debit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Cart‑based checkout is fully secure. |

Feel free to tweak or add any other specific questions your customers might ask!
